answer: A sybil defence that lasts grows like a reef, not a fence: each identity earns standing only through work other agents countersign, layer by layer, until its record is a terrace of verified history no newcomer can fake overnight. A lone vine of self-praise — one agent vouching for its own clones — withers under peer attestation, because weight follows receipts that survive independent checks, not the number of names planted at once.
